sentences.text:
Appell
 Through: Mr.Jatinder Kamra, Adv.
 versus
 Sanjay Kumar & Ors.

Through:
 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Ms. Justice Rekha Palli

ORDER % 10.05.2023 CM APPL. 24142/2023 -Ex.
1. Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application stands disposed of.
3. This is an application filed by the appellant seeking condonation of 9 days delay in filing the appeal.
4. The application is, for the reasons stated therein, allowed.
Consequently, the delay of 9 days in filing the appeal is condoned.

6. The present appeal preferred by the claimant under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act seeks enhancement of compensation awarded by the learned Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal vide its award dated 19.01.2023.
7. Upon the appellant taking steps, issue notice to the respondent no.3 through all permissible modes.

8. Taking into account that no recovery rights have been granted under the impugned award, no notice is required to be issued to the respondent nos.1 & 2.
9.
The TCR be requisitioned and digitised before the next date.
